profile_notes: Soft 20MP floor (near-universal on modern ILCs; functions as a floor not a filter, keeps 20MP+ bodies like the R6). Dynamic range is the dominant axis (bright windows vs dark interiors) -> sensor_performance weighted highest; resolution deliberately NOT separately weighted (ranks below DR, and lives inside sensor_performance). NO full-frame gate and NO 30MP gate: research (2026-08-17, note 2026-08-17-realestate-gear-research) confirmed crop bodies are legitimate and there is no high-res floor. Lighting method (HDR vs flambient) is co-equal, never crowned. Ratified by Lee 2026-08-17.
